extName.description: Extension name in chrome://extensions, the store listing, and the popup title. YouTube describes what it is for and is never the name itself.

extDescription.message: Follow YouTube channels without an account: one merged feed, alerts on new uploads, and a low-data audio mode.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the store listing. The stores cap it at 132 characters.

tabFeeds.description: Popup tab label for the merged video feed.

tabWatchlist.description: Popup tab label for the channel list.

tabAudio.description: Popup tab label for audio mode.

emptyFeeds.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when no channels have been added.

emptyWatchlist.description: Empty state on the Watchlist tab when no channels have been added.

nNewVideos.description: Desktop notification body when a channel uploaded more than one video since the last check. $COUNT$ is the number of new videos.

watchlistAdd.description: Button that adds a channel from the Watchlist input by URL or handle.

watchlistAddPlaceholder.message: Search your list, or a URL / @handle
watchlistAddPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and accessible name for the Watchlist box. The box filters the list as you type, and Add resolves a URL or handle.

watchlistOnList.description: Add button label when the typed URL or handle is already on the Watchlist.

watchlistAddFromTab.message: Add the channel from this tab
watchlistAddFromTab.description: Tooltip on the Add button when the Watchlist box is empty. Pressing Add then uses the focused browser tab.

watchlistNoCurrentTab.message: Open a YouTube channel or video first
watchlistNoCurrentTab.description: Inline error when Add is pressed with an empty box and the focused tab is not a YouTube channel or video.

watchlistClear.description: Accessible name of the ✕ that clears the Watchlist box.

watchlistShowing.description: Shown under the Watchlist box while it is filtering the list. $SHOWN$ is how many rows match; $TOTAL$ is the full list.

watchlistNoMatch.description: Empty state when the Watchlist box filtered the list to nothing and the text is not a URL or handle that can be added. $QUERY$ is what is in the box.

watchlistNoMatchAdd.message: Nobody on your watchlist matches "$QUERY$". Press Add to start watching them.
watchlistNoMatchAdd.description: Empty state when the Watchlist box filtered the list to nothing but the text is a URL or handle that can be added. $QUERY$ is what is in the box.

watchlistAlreadyAdded.description: Inline error when adding a channel that is already on the Watchlist.

watchlistNotAChannel.description: Inline error when the Watchlist input does not resolve to a YouTube channel.

watchlistError.description: Inline error for an unexpected worker failure. $ERROR$ is the worker's error text.

watchlistActions.description: Accessible name of the ⋯ control that opens a Watchlist row's action menu.

watchlistRemove.description: Menu item that removes the channel from the Watchlist immediately, with no confirmation. An Undo button appears afterwards.

watchlistRemoved.description: Status on the Watchlist after a channel is removed, next to the Undo button. $NAME$ is the channel name.

watchlistUndo.description: Button next to the removed-channel status that puts the channel and its videos back.

watchlistRestored.description: Green status on the Watchlist after Undo restores a removed channel. $NAME$ is the channel name.

channelProblemShort.description: Short red text on a Watchlist row whose last check failed. Opening the channel shows why.

channelProblemGone.message: YouTube can't find this channel's videos. It may have been deleted or made private.
channelProblemGone.description: Channel sheet, when YouTube answered 404 for the channel's feed and its Videos tab also failed.

channelProblemHttp.message: YouTube didn't answer for this channel (error $CODE$). It usually works again later.
channelProblemHttp.description: Channel sheet, when YouTube answered the channel's check with an HTTP error. $CODE$ is the status number, such as 500.

channelProblemNetwork.message: Couldn't reach YouTube. Check your internet connection.
channelProblemNetwork.description: Channel sheet, when the channel's last check could not reach YouTube at all.

channelProblemUnreadable.message: YouTube's answer for this channel couldn't be read.
channelProblemUnreadable.description: Channel sheet, when YouTube's answer for the channel could not be parsed.

channelProblemOther.message: The last check of this channel failed.
channelProblemOther.description: Channel sheet, when the channel's last check failed for a reason not covered by the other messages.

channelProblemRetry.description: Button beside the problem sentence in the channel sheet. Checks this one channel again.

followChannelLabel.description: Small label on the Follow card at the top of the Audio tab, when the focused tab is a YouTube channel page.

followVideoLabel.description: Small label on the Follow card at the top of the Audio tab, when the focused tab is a YouTube video.

followCollabLabel.description: Small label on the Follow card when the focused tab is a video made by several channels. Each channel gets its own row.

followingChannel.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the check mark before a channel name that is already on the Watchlist, on the Follow card and in the Audio tab's player card.

followButton.description: Button on the Follow card that adds the focused tab's channel to the Watchlist.

followButtonNamed.description: Accessible name of the Follow button when the channel name is known. $NAME$ is the channel name.

followDone.description: Green status on the Audio tab after the Follow button added a channel. $NAME$ is the channel name.

watchlistFavoriteAdd.description: Menu item that marks the channel as a favourite.

watchlistMuteAdd.description: Menu item that stops desktop alerts for this one channel. Its videos still show in the feed.

watchlistMuteRemove.description: Menu item that turns desktop alerts for this channel back on.

watchlistMuted.description: Short grey text on a Watchlist row whose alerts are muted.

watchlistFavorite.description: Marks a channel row as a favourite

watchlistFavoriteRemove.description: Menu item that unmarks the channel as a favourite.

watchlistOpenChannel.description: Accessible name of a Watchlist row. $TITLE$ is the channel title.

feedFilterPlaceholder.message: Search your feed, or a URL / @handle
feedFilterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and accessible name for the Feeds box. The box filters the feed as you type, and Add resolves a URL or handle to a channel.

feedClear.description: Accessible name of the ✕ that clears the Feeds box.

feedNoMatchAdd.message: No videos match "$QUERY$". Press Add to start watching this channel.
feedNoMatchAdd.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when the box filtered the list to nothing but the text is a URL or handle that can be added. $QUERY$ is what is in the box.

channelAdded.description: Green status under the Add box on Feeds or Watchlist after a channel is added.

feedFavoritesOnly.description: Checkbox on the Feeds tab that hides videos from channels that are not favourites.

feedFavoritesOnlyTitle.message: Hide videos from channels that are not favourites.
feedFavoritesOnlyTitle.description: Tooltip on the Favourites only checkbox on the Feeds tab.

feedRefresh.description: Accessible name of the Feeds refresh control, and the label of the refresh button in the empty-feed state.

feedShowMore.description: Button under the Feeds list that draws the next rows. $COUNT$ is how many, up to 50. Scrolling near it does the same.

feedLastSweep.description: Time of the last sweep, shown above the feed. $TIME$ is a relative timestamp such as 2h ago.

feedSweepRunning.description: Inline notice on the Feeds tab when a refresh is requested while a sweep is already in progress.

feedSlowDown.message: YouTube asked us to slow down. Checking again $TIME$.
feedSlowDown.description: Notice on the Feeds tab and the channel sheet while checks are paused because YouTube answered 429 or sent its unusual-traffic page. $TIME$ is a relative time such as in 15 min.

feedEmptyAdd.description: Button on the Feeds empty state that switches to the Watchlist tab when no channels have been added.

emptyFeedWaiting.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when channels exist but the feed has no videos yet.

feedFilterClear.description: Button that clears the Feeds text filter when it matched no videos.

emptyFeedFavorites.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when Favourites only is on and nothing from a favourite channel is visible.

emptyFeedFilter.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when the text filter matched nothing. $QUERY$ is the filter text.

feedTagLive.description: Tag on a feed row that is a live stream.

feedTagShort.description: Tag on a feed row that is a YouTube Short.

feedTagPremiere.description: Tag on a feed row that is a premiere with no upcoming start time to show.

feedTagPremiereAt.description: Tag on a premiere whose start time is still in the future. $TIME$ is a relative timestamp such as in 3h.

feedViews.description: View count on a feed row. $COUNT$ is a compact number such as 1.4M.

feedOpenVideo.description: Accessible name of a feed row. $TITLE$ is the video title.

feedOpenVideoAudio.description: Accessible name of a feed row or its button when that control opens the video in audio mode. $TITLE$ is the video title.

feedOpenVideoNormal.description: Accessible name of the per-row button that opens the video without audio mode. $TITLE$ is the video title.

feedOpenAudioShort.description: Tooltip on the per-row button that opens the video in audio mode.

feedOpenNormalShort.description: Tooltip on the per-row button that opens the video without audio mode.

sheetClose.description: Accessible name of the control that closes the channel sheet.

channelEmpty.description: Empty state on the channel sheet when this channel has no stored videos to show.

settingsNotifications.description: Settings group heading for desktop alert controls.

settingsAlertsEnabled.description: Master switch for desktop alerts on new uploads.

settingsAlertsEnabledTitle.message: Master switch for desktop alerts on new uploads.
settingsAlertsEnabledTitle.description: Tooltip on the master notifications switch.

settingsNotifyNormal.description: Switch that lets non-favourite channels raise desktop alerts.

settingsNotifyNormalTitle.message: Favourites always alert while notifications are on. This switch is only for the rest.
settingsNotifyNormalTitle.description: Tooltip on the non-favourite notification switch.

settingsNotifyNormalNote.message: Favourites always alert while notifications are on.
settingsNotifyNormalNote.description: Visible note under the non-favourite notification switch.

settingsUseAvatar.message: Use the channel's avatar as the alert icon
settingsUseAvatar.description: Switch that uses the channel avatar on desktop alerts.

settingsUseAvatarTitle.message: When off, alerts use the extension icon instead.

settingsChecking.description: Settings group heading for poll interval controls.

settingsPollAllBefore.description: Label before the all-channels poll interval input.

settingsPollAllAfter.description: Label after the all-channels poll interval input.

settingsPollAllTitle.message: YouTube caches the feed for 15 minutes, so a shorter interval only helps because the request bypasses that cache.
settingsPollAllTitle.description: Tooltip on the all-channels poll interval.

settingsPollFavBefore.description: Label before the favourites poll interval input.

settingsPollFavAfter.description: Label after the favourites poll interval input.

settingsPollFavTitle.message: 0 turns this extra check off. YouTube caches the feed for 15 minutes, so a shorter interval only helps because the request bypasses that cache.
settingsPollFavTitle.description: Tooltip on the favourites poll interval.

settingsPollCacheNote.message: YouTube caches the feed for 15 minutes, so a shorter interval only helps because the request bypasses that cache.
settingsPollCacheNote.description: Visible note under the poll interval controls.

settingsFeed.description: Settings group heading for feed retention and shorts.

settingsFeedMaxBefore.description: Label before the feed retention input.

settingsFeedMaxAfter.description: Label after the feed retention input.

settingsFeedMaxTitle.message: Oldest videos fall off the feed when this cap is reached.
settingsFeedMaxTitle.description: Tooltip on the feed retention input.

settingsShowShorts.description: Switch that includes YouTube Shorts in the feed and badge.

settingsShowShortsTitle.message: Off hides shorts from the feed and from the toolbar badge.

settingsKeys.description: Settings group heading for the extension's keyboard shortcuts.

settingsKeyPopup.description: Settings row label for the shortcut that opens the extension's popup.

settingsKeyAudio.description: Settings row label for the shortcut that toggles audio mode on the active YouTube tab.

settingsKeyNone.description: Shown in place of a key combination when Chrome bound no shortcut, usually because another extension had it.

settingsKeysChange.description: Settings button that opens the browser's page for changing extension shortcuts.

settingsLanguage.description: Settings group heading for the UI language.

settingsLocale.description: Label for the UI language select.

settingsLocaleTitle.description: Tooltip on the UI language select.

settingsLocaleAuto.description: Language option that follows the browser language.

settingsLocaleEn.description: Language option that pins the UI to English.

settingsLocaleAr.description: Language option that pins the UI to Arabic.

settingsBackup.description: Settings group heading for export and import.

settingsExport.description: Button that downloads a JSON backup of settings and channels.

settingsExportTitle.message: Download your settings and channel list as a JSON file.

settingsImport.description: Button that starts restoring a JSON backup file.

settingsImportTitle.message: Restore a previously exported file. Merge adds new channels; Replace overwrites everything.

settingsImportPrompt.message: How should this file be applied?
settingsImportPrompt.description: Prompt shown after a backup file is chosen, before Merge or Replace.

settingsImportMerge.description: Applies a backup by adding channels that are not already present.

settingsImportReplace.description: Starts replacing all channels and settings with the backup file.

settingsImportReplacePrompt.message: Replace all channels and settings with this file?
settingsImportReplacePrompt.description: Inline confirmation prompt before a destructive Replace import.

settingsImportReplaceConfirm.description: Confirms replacing all channels and settings with the backup file.

settingsImportReplaceCancel.description: Cancels a Replace import and returns to Merge or Replace.

settingsImportAdded.description: Status after a Merge import. $ADDED$ is new channels; $SKIPPED$ were already in the list.

settingsImportReplaced.description: Status after a Replace import. $ADDED$ is how many channels the file contained.

settingsExportDone.description: Status after a backup file is downloaded. $COUNT$ is the number of channels written.

settingsFooterChannels.description: Settings footer line with the number of watched channels. $COUNT$ is the count.

settingsFooterFeed.description: Settings footer line with the number of feed items. $COUNT$ is the count.

settingsFooterNever.description: Settings footer line when no sweep has run yet.

settingsFooterVersion.description: Settings footer line with the extension version from the manifest. $VERSION$ is the version string.

cmdToggleAudioMode.description: Keyboard command that pins or unpins 144p audio mode on the active YouTube tab. Chrome may register it with no shortcut if the suggested key is already taken.

overlayTitle.description: Title on the in-page overlay while audio mode is covering the video.

overlayExit.description: Label of the overlay button that turns audio mode off, used when no keyboard shortcut is bound.

overlayExitShortcut.description: Label of the overlay button that turns audio mode off, used when a keyboard shortcut is bound. $SHORTCUT$ is the bound combination such as Alt+Shift+A.

audioModeLabel.description: Label next to the master audio-mode toggle on the Audio tab.

audioModeToggle.message: Turn audio mode on or off
audioModeToggle.description: Accessible name of the master audio-mode toggle.

audioModeToggleTitle.message: Turn audio mode on or off on the selected YouTube tab.
audioModeToggleTitle.description: Tooltip on the master audio-mode toggle.

audioPageNotice.message: Open a YouTube video to use audio mode.
audioPageNotice.description: Notice on the Audio tab when no controllable YouTube tab is open.

audioRestoreQuality.description: Label of the select that sets the fallback quality used when audio mode turns off.

audioRestoreQualityTitle.message: Fallback only. A captured 720p, 1080p or 4K still wins on switch-off.
audioRestoreQualityTitle.description: Tooltip on the restore-quality select. The value is the fallback when switch-on capture is tiny, small, missing, or unrecognised.

audioQualityAuto.description: Restore-quality option that lets YouTube pick the level.

audioQualityHd720.description: Restore-quality option for 720p. The default fallback.

audioQualityHighres.description: Restore-quality option that asks for the player's highest level.

audioSleep.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the Audio tab select that pauses the video after a set time.

audioSleepOff.description: Sleep timer option: no timer. Keep it short; the select is narrow.

audioSleep15.description: Sleep timer option: pause after 15 minutes. Keep it short.

audioSleep30.description: Sleep timer option: pause after 30 minutes. Keep it short.

audioSleep60.description: Sleep timer option: pause after 60 minutes. Keep it short.

audioSleepLeft.description: Shown in the sleep timer select while a timer runs. $MINUTES$ is the whole minutes left, rounded up. Keep it short.

audioShortcutBound.description: Audio tab hint when a keyboard shortcut is bound. $SHORTCUT$ is the real combination from chrome.commands, such as Alt+Shift+A.

audioShortcutNone.message: No shortcut assigned — click to set one
audioShortcutNone.description: Audio tab hint when Chrome registered the command with no shortcut. Clicking opens chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

audioShortcutTitle.message: Click to set the keyboard shortcut.
audioShortcutTitle.description: Tooltip on the Audio tab shortcut hint before JavaScript replaces it with the bound or empty copy.

audioPickerLabel.description: Accessible name of the row of open YouTube tabs the Audio tab can drive.

audioPickerTab.description: Accessible name of one open-tab picker entry. $TITLE$ is the video title.

audioPlayerBack.description: Accessible name of the player-card skip-back button.

audioPlayerPlay.description: Accessible name of the player-card play button while the video is paused.

audioPlayerPause.description: Accessible name of the player-card pause button while the video is playing.

audioPlayerForward.description: Accessible name of the player-card skip-forward button.

audioPlayerSpeed.description: Accessible name of the player-card playback-speed select.

audioPlayerVolume.description: Accessible name of the player-card volume select.

audioVolumeMute.description: Volume option that sets the player to 0.

audioPlayerNoTitle.description: Player-card title when the target tab has no video title.

audioStatsFilter.description: Accessible name of the This Month / All Time filter group.

audioStatsThisMonth.description: Audio tab statistics filter for the current calendar month.

audioStatsAllTime.description: Audio tab statistics filter for never-pruned running totals.

audioStatsUsed.description: Label of the card showing estimated data used at 144p.

audioStatsSaved.description: Label of the card showing estimated data saved against 720p.

audioStatsListened.description: Label of the card showing media seconds counted while audio mode was on.

audioStatsActive.description: Label of the card showing wall seconds the audio-mode session was up.

audioStatsUnitMb.description: Megabyte unit suffix passed to formatData, including the leading space.

audioStatsUnitGb.description: Gigabyte unit suffix passed to formatData, including the leading space.

settingsOpenFeedInAudio.message: Open feed videos in audio mode
settingsOpenFeedInAudio.description: Settings checkbox that makes a feed-row click open the video with audio mode already on.

settingsOpenFeedInAudioTitle.message: On, clicking a video opens it with audio mode already on, and its button opens it normally.
settingsOpenFeedInAudioTitle.description: Tooltip on the Open feed videos in audio mode checkbox.

settingsAudio.description: Settings group heading for audio mode: opening feed videos in it, and the in-page overlay appearance.

settingsAudioBgType.description: Label of the Colour / Image select for the audio-mode overlay.

settingsAudioBgTypeTitle.message: Colour paints a gradient or a custom colour. Image uses the URL below.
settingsAudioBgTypeTitle.description: Tooltip on the overlay background-type select.

settingsAudioBgColor.description: Background-type option that uses a preset gradient or a custom colour.

settingsAudioBgImage.description: Background-type option that uses an image URL.

settingsAudioPresets.description: Label of the overlay gradient swatches and the custom colour picker.

settingsAudioPresetsTitle.message: The overlay on the page uses the same colours as these swatches.
settingsAudioPresetsTitle.description: Tooltip on the overlay preset swatches.

audioPresetMidnight.description: Name of the default dark overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetSlate.description: Name of the slate overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetEmber.description: Name of the ember overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetAmber.description: Name of the amber overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetForest.description: Name of the forest overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetSunset.description: Name of the sunset overlay gradient preset.

audioPresetCustom.description: Accessible name of the custom overlay colour picker.

settingsAudioImageUrl.description: Label of the overlay background image URL field.

settingsAudioImageUrlTitle.message: Paste a direct link to an image. Only https and data:image URLs are kept.
settingsAudioImageUrlTitle.description: Tooltip on the overlay image URL field.

settingsAudioImageApply.description: Button that saves the overlay image URL.

settingsAudioImageHint.message: Paste a direct link to an image.
settingsAudioImageHint.description: Hint under the overlay image URL field.

supportOpen.description: Accessible name of the header heart and the Settings button that open the support sheet.

supportIntro.message: It's free, with no ads and no tracking. If it saves you time or data, you can chip in.
supportIntro.description: Short explanation on the support sheet that the extension is free.

supportOpenLink.description: Button that opens a support method's link in a new tab.

supportCopy.description: Button that copies a support method's address.

supportCopied.description: Button label shown briefly after the address was copied.

supportCopyFailed.message: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it yourself.
supportCopyFailed.description: Shown in the method row when the address could not be copied.

supportShowQr.description: Button that reveals a support method's QR code.

supportHideQr.description: Button that hides a support method's QR code.

supportQrAlt.description: Alt text for a method's QR image. $ADDRESS$ is the payment address.

supportPaypalHint.message: Card or PayPal balance, from anywhere.
supportPaypalHint.description: Hint under the PayPal support method.

supportInstapayHint.message: From any Egyptian bank or wallet app with InstaPay.
supportInstapayHint.description: Hint under the InstaPay support method.

settingsSupport.description: Settings group heading for supporting the project.

settingsSupportText.message: Free, with no ads. Chip in if it helps you.
settingsSupportText.description: Short note under the Settings support heading.
